text:
maya: Found a bottle of kombucha in the kitchen labeled 'v1.0.0' — do we semver drinks now? :tophat:

devon: Only if you bump to v1.0.1 when it gets fizzy :joy:

sam: patch release for carbonation, minor for flavor changes, major when it becomes soda

lee: welcome to the repo of beverages. also, please don't put colons in labels, YAML is not forgiving

lee: ```
# Someone's lunch label
kombucha: ginger:
  version: 0.1.0
```

chris: that YAML will orphan half the fridge 😬 :laughing:

ops-bot: fridge-reminder-bot: Reminder: fridge cleanout this Friday at 4pm. Anything unlabeled will be donated to the compiler. :robot_face:

maya: @ops-bot noted. I'll add a CHANGELOG.md to the kombucha collection.

devon: can we add a test that runs `yamllint` on condiment labels? :thinking_face:

sam: PR welcome. I'll write the test that asserts 'v' prefix for all beverage versions

lee: also we need migration scripts for 'pre-ferment' tags

chris: meeting invite: 'Kombucha Versioning Board — 30m' :calendar:

maya: lol let's keep it a quick 10m sync at the watercooler. Bring stickers for 'major' releases.
